seed.text: Fix the broken image upload on recipe pages
Add a sitemap.xml for the recipe pages

turns: Image upload on recipe pages is broken again, uploads over 2 MB fail.

The upload handler had a 2 MB limit hard-coded, separate from the 10 MB limit in the config. I removed the hard-coded value so it uses the config. I tested a 6 MB photo and it uploads and shows on the recipe page.
Works for me too. The sitemap still isn't there, but not today.
Ok, I left the sitemap. The upload fix is committed.
I'll deploy the upload fix to production tonight.
Sounds good. Remember to clear the CDN cache after the deploy so old error pages don't stick.
